# Burnout at Work

## Signs of burnout
Burnout is a state of long-term exhaustion linked to work stress. Signs include constant tiredness, feeling detached or cynical about your job, and reduced performance.

## Recovery strategies
Set clear limits on working hours and protect time to rest. Take short breaks during the day and use your leave. Talk to your manager about workload, and ask for support early rather than waiting until you are exhausted.

Physical activity, time with friends and hobbies unrelated to work all help recovery.
